scope: H2-01 E0 model-only diagnostics, never a passing original full cohort.
cutoff_rationale: Bound resource use before outcomes are known. Both previous baselines finished before 7.2 s. Any 30 s cutoff is stalled/incomplete, cannot count as a repair, and does not change the original 600 s audit.

trials.name: baseline
trials.rationale: Repeat strong-loop input; diagnostic cutoff changes only termination, all recorded metrics must exactly match the earlier completed run.

trials.name: tolerance_1e10
trials.rationale: Change only the Newton early-termination tolerance.

trials.name: tolerance_1e12
trials.rationale: Second precision level at the original time step.

trials.name: tolerance_1e12_half_dt
trials.rationale: Precision plus step refinement; reference for the following single-factor compliance changes.

trials.name: stiffer_loops
trials.rationale: Change only loop time constant relative to tolerance_1e12_half_dt; >= 2 dt.

trials.name: stiffer_contact
trials.rationale: Change only mass-normalised contact stiffness relative to tolerance_1e12_half_dt; physical assumption, not only numerical precision.

trials.name: stiffer_both
trials.rationale: Joint compliance sensitivity; not an isolated-factor attribution.

trials.name: rigid_limit_probe
trials.rationale: Stronger joint/contact constraints with refined step; probes a limit, does not establish convergence.

comparison_rule: Retain every outcome and all native metrics/findings. Compare numerical precision separately from compliance changes. Check original baseline metrics bit-for-bit. Record whole-run iteration histogram and all standard runner telemetry with hashes. Never promote a stalled or short-window result.

sources.summary: Constraint solver early-termination tolerance is distinct from its iteration cap; zero disables early termination.

limits: No physical measurement or independent dynamics solver.
Two selected cases cannot establish a full-cohort pass.
Changing contact stiffness changes the assumed physical model.
NoSlip omitted because previous declared trials already retained its 600 s stall.
